indicator_name: Moody's Baa corporate yield spread over 10-year Treasury, monthly average
description: Спред доходности корпоративных облигаций Baa (Moody's) к 10-летним казначейским облигациям США, среднее за месяц
methodology: Percentage points, Moody's Baa corporate bond yield less the 10-year Treasury yield, monthly average (a credit-risk premium; the ICE BofA high-yield spread is licensed for internal use only and FRED serves just its last three years). FRED series BAA10Y.
